newsitem.title: UK: Winchester Commodities Group scales down operation.
newsitem.headline: Winchester Commodities Group scales down operation.

text.p: The Winchester Commodities Group is scaling back the activities of Winchester Brokerage, including trading in base metals markets, the group's managing director Stephen Heath said.

He said the company was forced to curtail its activities because of the low level of business in base metal markets in general during recent weeks and because of adverse publicity in the press concerning the Sumitomo scandal in June.

"Post the Sumitomo affair the level of overall business in the metals market has been very low, and I believe that a number of other players in the metal markets are also looking at a retrenchment," Heath told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"Specifically as regards Winchester the continued adverse publicity that the company has had...has damaged severely customer-client relationships and also damaged staff morale."

"As a consequence of those factors we are scaling back certain of our activities. That will result in a number of redundancies in the company." But the firm will continue to trade through Winchester Asset Management, Heath said.
